heading: Authorized strengths: commissioned officers in an active status

tree.text: The authorized strengths of the Army, Navy, Air Force, and Marine Corps in reserve commissioned officers, other than commissioned warrant officers and officers on an active-duty list, in an active status are as follows: Army275,000 Air Force200,000 Navy150,000 Marine Corps24,500.
The authorized strengths prescribed by subsection (a) may not be exceeded unless—

children.text: the Secretary concerned determines that a greater number is necessary for planned mobilization requirements; or
the excess results directly from the operation of a nondiscretionary provision of law.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: Provisions similar to those in this section were contained in sections 3217, 5414, and 8217 of this title, prior to repeal by Pub. L. 103–337, § 1662(a)(3).

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Dec. 1, 1994, except as otherwise provided, see section 1691 of Pub. L. 103–337, set out as a note under section 10001 of this title.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 103–337, div. A, title XVI, § 1662(a)(1), Oct. 5, 1994, 108 Stat. 2984.)
